articles.summary: Qingshuiyan Ancestral Hall Supporting Facility Renovation Set within the core scenic area of the thousand-year-old Qingshuiyan Ancestral Hall in Anxi, Quanzhou , this project renovates a decommissioned old bus station left unused after its functional relocation. The site is anchored by a moss-draped ancient banyan tree at the center of a forest-framed open square, with a dilapidated two-story station building, native rock formations, and ancient mossy paths defining its unique natural and historic context. articles.title: Yaesu Daibiru Office Building / Nikken Sekkei
articles.summary: Project Background and Inheritance of Design Thinking - This project is the redevelopment of a tenant office building facing Yaesu-dori Ave., a landmark street in front of Tokyo Station. The former building, designed by leading 20th-century Japanese architect Togo Murano (1891–1984), long defined the character of the streetscape through its distinctive facade combining stone and cast aluminum components. articles.title: Sungui Church Cultural Space (ㅅㄱ) / SML
articles.summary: The Korean name 'ㅅㄱ' derives from Sukkoth, a place mentioned in the Old Testament. Sukkoth was the first place where the Israelites camped after leaving Egypt. It offered those who had not yet reached the Promised Land a place to pause, find shelter, and prepare to continue their journey. Located in the old urban neighborhood of Sungui-dong, Michuhol-gu, Incheon , Sungui Church Cultural Space brings this ancient meaning into the contemporary city.

articles.title: Casa Vereda / L'Aura Ortín Architecture for Happiness
articles.summary: Casa Vereda stems from a simple idea: to inhabit nature without competing with it. The project blends into the landscape through an architecture that seeks to become part of its surroundings. Volumes, materials, and textures engage in a dialogue with vegetation, light, and the memory of the place, creating a house that seems to have always been there.

articles.title: House AC / Kiko Castello Branco Arquitetura + Lucas Cunha
articles.summary: The design of Casa AC consists of a pavilion attached to an existing house located in the interior of the state of São Paulo. This new space houses a living area with a kitchen, a large dining table, and an integrated living room, as well as a guest suite on the ground floor — designed especially for visitors with reduced mobility — and a changing room supporting the existing pool on the property.

articles.title: Monte Alvo House / NOZ Arquitectura
articles.summary: The architectural tradition of the Alentejo is defined by simplicity of form, functional spaces, and a deep connection with climate and landscape . At the top of Monte Alvo, the house is single-story, positioned to make full use of solar orientation and ensure thermal comfort throughout the year.

articles.title: The Town House / Sigurd Larsen
articles.summary: The local vernacular is defined by two-story houses and pitched roofs lining the narrow streets of the historic village of Niedersprockhövel in Germany.
